note: Public-safe, hermetic test specimens. All are genuine output of real C2PA implementations; none was hand-authored. Digests are recorded so a consumer can re-acquire the exact bytes.

c2pa-rs-fixtures.pin_note: Reconnaissance fetched these from branch main before a commit was pinned, so their acquisition was digest-recorded but not commit-recorded. They were re-acquired here under the explicit commit above and every digest matched the recorded value, closing that gap.

captured-remote-manifest.pin_note: A live remote manifest store has no upstream commit to pin. Its identity here is its digest, captured once and frozen. It is never re-fetched: the test suite replays these bytes.
